set.body:
Purpose: make EyeLink ingestion scientifically trustworthy without reverse-engineering or bundling the proprietary EDF binary format. The portable contract is vendor EDF2ASC conversion followed by a lossless, stateful, streaming ASC parser. Direct EDF support remains outside the portable core.

Exit criteria:
- A published support matrix names every validated converter/configuration/layout and labels untested configurations unsupported.
- Every nonblank ASC source line is represented exactly once as a typed record, preserved unknown record, or line-numbered diagnostic.
- GAZE, HREF, RAW, pupil semantics, native events, missingness, message offsets, clocks, and monocular/binocular identity are never silently coerced.
- Whole-input and arbitrary byte/chunk streaming executions are observationally equal.
- Parsed canonical manifests agree with independent EDF Access API and vendor ASC reference oracles under named field-specific tolerances.
- Targeted semantic mutants fail; JVM and Scala.js canonical manifests agree.
- Representative long recordings meet declared throughput and peak-memory budgets.
- A release-bound validation artifact records source/converter/oracle digests, corpus coverage, platform results, limitations, and provenance.
- A real EDF-derived ASC reaches validated recording(s), ObservedTimeline, native-event evidence, and a downstream scanpath with complete diagnostics.

Out of scope: reverse-engineering EDF, bundling EDFAPI, silently invoking vendor tooling, treating EyeLink online events as eyes4s DetectionResult, or claiming configurations absent from the validation matrix.
set.title: EyeLink ASC ingestion reliability and certification
